prompt:

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, horizontal 16:9, a cool blue-grey low-saturation grade under pale flat overcast daylight, quiet still melancholic present-day mood. The frame opens exactly on <Picture 1>: a POV from the bedroom doorway, seen between two pale floral curtains, looking into a cool blue-grey bedroom. Just inside the doorway, seen from behind, stands the same single East Asian Chinese man about 28, oval face, soft short neatly-cut black hair with a natural side part (not a buzz cut), clean-shaven, wearing a DEEP NAVY BLUE plain crew-neck short-sleeve tee and matching deep navy home pants (navy on navy). Preserve his appearance, his navy-on-navy clothing, and the room anchors: the made wooden double bed, the nightstand lamp, the framed landscape painting above the headboard, the hanging plant by the sheer-curtained window, the dresser, the bookshelf on the right, and the patterned rug. The camera holds an almost static shot with only a faint near-imperceptible drift. He has paused in the doorway as if habitually returning to the room after making breakfast; he stays still for a beat, then his head lowers and turns slightly toward the bed so a sliver of his profile becomes visible. His gaze travels slowly across the two pillows and the bedspread — one half of the bed lies perfectly smooth and empty while the other half, the side where he slept, is faintly creased. He registers the untouched empty side; his shoulders sink with a slow exhale. Over the final seconds a small bittersweet smile forms at the corner of his mouth in partial profile — a knowing, wistful half-smile that does not reach his eyes — before his expression quietly settles and he holds still. Clean frame with no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no Chinese characters and no watermark anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: A hollow morning emptiness fills the room — a slow single water drip, the steady ticking of a wall clock, and a thin layer of early-morning room tone under near-complete silence, with the soft rustle of his tee as he shifts his weight.
